sloka: तेषाम् निग्रहणे शक्तः स्वयम् च कुशिकात्मजः ।तव पुत्र हितार्थाय त्वाम् उपेत्य अभि याचते ॥१-२१-२१॥
transliteration: teṣām nigrahaṇe śaktaḥ svayam ca kuśikātmajaḥ ।tava putra hitārthāya tvām upetya abhi yācate ॥1-21-21॥

translations.english: Satisfied in his mind at the words of the sage (Vasishta), the full one among the Raghus' (Dasaratha) one with wide reputation, his frame shining gave his cheerful consent to the son of Kusika for Rama's departure. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये बालकाण्डे एकविंशस्सर्ग:।। Thus ends the twentyfirst sarga of Balakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
translations.hindi: हे धमेज्ञ! आप मेरे बच्चे पर और मुझ पर कृपा करे, क्योंकि आप तो झुक अल्पसाग्य वाले के केवल देवता की तरह पूज्य ही नहीं, किन्तु गुरु भी हैं
